industry: Luxury Haute Couture, Embroidered Lawn & Bridal Wear

brand_guidelines.mission: Celebrating feminine grace, heritage artisanal craftsmanship, and contemporary Pakistani royal aesthetics.

typography_rules.casing: Title Case or Elegant Serif Small Caps

banned_elements: No cartoonish styles, cliparts, or modern tech gradients
No distorted anatomy, fingers, or warped facial expressions
NEVER hallucinate, repaint, or distort authentic garment embroidery
No cheap sales banners, neon badges, or aggressive discount graphics

product_accuracy_rule.instructions: CRITICAL PRODUCT INTEGRITY MANDATE: The AI must NEVER generate or alter the garments, fabric weaves, or embroidery motifs. The workflow accepts real Slack photo attachments of the authentic Maria B clothing. The image generator is strictly restricted to generating heritage architectural backdrops (e.g., Mughal arches, sunlit marble pavilions, botanical verandas, soft golden hour lighting) and regal typographic overlays around the authentic garment.
